cues: The carpels form the gynoecium: each pistil has an ovary, a style and a stigma.
Inside the ovary are ovules, the megasporangia, which make megaspores.
Two different kinds of spore: angiosperms are heterosporous.
text: The carpels form the gynoecium: each pistil has an ovary, a style and a stigma. Inside the ovary are ovules, the megasporangia, which make megaspores. Two different kinds of spore: angiosperms are heterosporous.
